records.text: Her husband's gay. She's madly in love with Charlie (Charlie Kirk). No, never mind, go back to her being a lesbian. It is dizzying, but somebody's got to do it, and apparently those somebodies are in Eastern Europe. Pam Besley writes, hi Candace (Candace Owens), Catholic homeschooling wine mom here. I've got six kids. Can you throw me a bone and let me borrow a nanny? I actually heard you secretly have 20, because why not? They fit in your mansion. Let me be very clear.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
